items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: The fellow that married Sarah Vaughan? What was his name?

ctx.x: Miles was one of the ones he wanted to let out. The fellow that married Sarah Vaughan? What was his name?
Yeah, Sarah’s first husband. He was the manager.
